candidate_061.name: revocable validity-state memory with trial-gated re-promotion
candidate_061.mechanism_hypothesis: Represent reusable evidence as keyed precedents with explicit Hypothesis/Active/Revoked lifecycle state. Fresh same-key contradictory evidence must remove the superseded item from ordinary retrieval while preserving it in an audit archive. When executable validation is available, candidate re-promotion should require support, counterfactual-harm, and contamination checks rather than semantic relevance alone.

primary_evidence.source: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents, arXiv:2608.07429v2
primary_evidence.design: Matched deterministic hidden-regime and real file-backed drift streams over 50 seeds plus a preference-update stream; shared task streams/evaluators across mechanism baselines. MemoryAgentBench SH-6k uses a fixed DeepSeek-v4-Flash backend and matched query orders.
primary_evidence.interpretation: The no-revocation ablation collapses to append-only behavior, directly identifying stale-item deactivation as the essential operation in hidden reversal. Preference updates separate promotion validation from lifecycle revocation: adding the same validation rule to last-write-wins helps materially, yet the remaining TEPA gap shows that filtering new writes does not remove an already-active stale item. The clean single-hop benchmark is an important boundary: when the latest fact is directly observed, simple current-key replacement matches TEPA.
primary_evidence.limits: Conflict keys are schema-defined/deterministic in reported core experiments, so open-ended semantic contradiction detection remains hard. Multi-hop and very-long-context results collapse, showing this does not solve retrieval-chain construction or context selection. The main drift executors are deterministic and are not an autonomous-science benchmark.

candidate_061.relation_to_existing: Strengthens candidate_058 by adding an explicit active/revoked lifecycle and candidate_055/056 by separating write-time validation from post-activation invalidation. Superseded values should remain auditable but cease to be active prompt evidence.
candidate_061.status: New mechanism candidate with strong matched stale-conflict evidence and explicit boundary failures.

candidate_062.name: dual-grain exemplar-schema memory with utility-conditioned retrieval
candidate_062.mechanism_hypothesis: Store both instance-grounded exemplars and abstract reusable schemas, and condition schema retrieval on observed utility as well as similarity. Use the exemplar channel to guard against schema over-generalization and the schema channel to transfer across superficially dissimilar cases.

primary_evidence.source: DG-Mem: Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner, arXiv:2608.23268v1
primary_evidence.design: Frozen-backbone, non-parametric memory built offline from training rollouts and read-only at held-out test time across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four backbones. Utility is learned by Shapley-style rule-subset rollouts and combined with retrieval similarity.
primary_evidence.interpretation: Across multiple backbones the combined memory is usually stronger than no-memory and single-grain ablations, and on Gemini utility-aware retrieval adds 0.6/0.7/2.1 points over using both memories with similarity only. The schema-only MMMU result falls below baseline, providing a useful negative control: abstract rules can over-generalize and need grounding/correction. Qwen3.5-27B also worsens on MMMU-Pro (75.1 to 73.6) despite positive average improvement, so the mechanism is not uniformly beneficial per task.
primary_evidence.limits: This is multimodal math/science reasoning rather than a long-horizon autonomous-scientist workflow. Memory is constructed offline from training rollouts and frozen at test, so staleness, contradiction lifecycle, and sequential research-memory mutation are not tested. Exact component numbers were cross-checked against an indexed mirror of the arXiv HTML because the official experimental HTML endpoint was not retrievable through the current web transport; the arXiv abstract independently confirms the four-backbone design and overall improvement.

candidate_062.relation_to_existing: Complements candidate_057/058: not an authority/lifecycle mechanism, but evidence that retrieval should compose instance-specific evidence with abstract schemas and observed utility instead of relying on a single memory grain or similarity alone.
candidate_062.status: New cross-backbone positive-control candidate; science-agent transfer remains untested.

structured_controlled_experiment_loop.source: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models, arXiv:2608.23622v1, accepted ETFA 2026
structured_controlled_experiment_loop.design: Five pharmaceutical crystallization optimization tasks. All agent-based variants use GPT-4o; variants remove simulation functions or the Requirement Analyzer, with a GPT-4o direct-prompt baseline. Two senior domain specialists rate correctness/helpfulness.
structured_controlled_experiment_loop.interpretation: Explicitly structuring task requirements before selecting controlled interventions trades a small amount of simulation-call recall for a large precision gain and higher user-rated correctness/helpfulness; removing experimental execution makes outputs too vague for the domain users. This strengthens the existing execution-grounded/evidence-localization line: intervention planning should be tied to explicit requirements and observable comparative evidence, not language-only plausibility.
structured_controlled_experiment_loop.limits: Only five task scenarios, one LLM backbone, two specialist raters, and a proprietary first-principles/semi-empirical simulator. Simulation confirmation is consistency with that simulator, not independent real-world truth or external validity.

parallel_frontier_search.memory_frontier: TEPA supplies strong lifecycle-revocation evidence but exposes multi-hop/long-context failure; DG-Mem supplies multi-backbone positive control for dual-grain/utility-conditioned retrieval but not sequential science. Next prioritize a science-domain experiment combining bounded active claim-evidence state, explicit revocation, contradiction-aware retrieval, and multi-backbone or multi-seed evaluation.
